thread:
maya: heads-up — meridian8b (gptq-int4) shows a small but consistent quality drop on the summarization eval after we switched to grouped quant. also seeing memory churn / occasional OOMs when default max_new_tokens=256 on 4xA10 pods. anyone tracking this?

alex: saw the same on my canary runs. hallucination +2.4% F1 drop vs fp16 baseline on our news-summary set. logs? repro steps?

maya: ran a 5k prompt batch on canary, attaching short logs below. eval-bot flagged regression run. gist: https://redwood.gists/meridian-quant-jan9

sam: quick theory — grouped quant reduces per-head fidelity for some attention heads, hits summarization. also long max_new_tokens keeps KV alive and fragments memory -> churn. two quick mitigations: revert grouping -> per-channel, and lower default max_new_tokens to 128 for interactive endpoints; also bump kv eviction sensitivity.

ria: can try config: per-channel gptq, batch sizing differences (1 for latency, 4 for throughput), kv_eviction_threshold=0.6. i can patch canary now.

maya: thanks. i'll run per-channel gptq canary with max_new_tokens=128 and kv_eviction_threshold=0.6. config i'm applying: ```model_config:
  quant: gptq
  grouping: per_channel
  max_new_tokens: 128
  kv_eviction_threshold: 0.6
  batch_size: 4```

eval-bot: Eval run started: meridian8b-perchannel-128-evict. id: run_2026_01_09_13. summary: RougeL -1.1% vs float16 baseline; hallucination rate down 4.8% -> 3.2%; median latency +2ms. full results: https://redwood.evals/run_2026_01_09_13

alex: interesting — hallucinations down but still some quality gap. sampling/temp identical between runs?

maya: sampling fixed (top_p=0.95, temp=0.0) for eval purity.

sam: if gap persists, try smaller group_size (16->8) or residual calibration for quant. another lever: hybrid precision for final layers (last 1-2 in fp16).

ria: running layered hybrid now: last_2_layers_fp16=true on canary, will post quick numbers.

ria: quick numbers back — hybrid run: RougeL -0.4% vs fp16 baseline, hallucination 1.8%, mem peak -12%. latency +4ms. seems promising.

maya: ok let's keep hybrid as default for meridian8b canary. patching to staging and will monitor OOM/fragmentation.

alex: should we change API default max_new_tokens for meridian8b only? plan for rollout?

maya: yes — model-specific default max_new_tokens=128 exposed in console. rollout plan: canary 5% 24h -> 50% 24h -> 100%. will add monitor for hallucination/regression on production prompts.

sam: :thumbsup: i'll open the rollout PR and update gating rules.

eval-bot: reg-check: no regression detected on key production prompt sample (10k). ok to proceed to 50% after 2h smoke.

maya: thanks all. follow-ups: create an eval ticket to sweep long-form creative prompts and schedule a quant calibration sweep next week.

(threads like this are short — followup tickets: #EVAL-3421, #INF-879)
